import sys
sys.setrecursionlimit(10000)
def f(N,M, edges):
    if M == 0: return 1
    prev = edges[-1]
    bottoms = [i[0] for i in edges if i[1] == prev[0] or i[1] == prev[1]]
    heights = [i[1] for i in edges if i[0] == prev[0] or i[0] == prev[1]]
    sub_Qs = [f(N, sum([1 for i in edges if (i[0] in bottoms and i[1] in heights)])-1, [i for i in edges if i[0] in bottoms and i[1] in heights])]
    return 2**(sum([1 for i in edges if (i[0] in [j[1] for j in sub_Qs] and j[0] not in heights) or (i[1] in [j[1] for j in sub_Qs] and j[0] not in bottoms)]))*sub_Qs[0]
```
